steps.en: Install it from your package manager, a release binary, or Cargo
steps.zh: 用包管理器、release 二进制或 Cargo 装上

steps.en: Optionally write a TOML config for fonts, colors and key bindings
steps.zh: 按需写一个 TOML 配置，定字体、配色和快捷键

steps.en: Starts your shell behind a pseudo-terminal and parses what it prints into a grid of cells
steps.zh: 在伪终端后启动你的 shell，把它的输出解析成字符格子

steps.en: Draws that grid on the GPU with OpenGL, so floods of output stay smooth
steps.zh: 用 OpenGL 在 GPU 上画这张格子，大量输出也不卡

steps.en: Watches the config file and applies changes when you save it
steps.zh: 盯着配置文件，你一保存就生效

value.en: A fast, identical terminal on every OS; tabs and splits stay with tmux or your window manager
value.zh: 每个系统上都是同一个快速终端；标签页和分屏仍交给 tmux 或窗口管理器

sources: https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty#configuration (config search paths incl. $HOME/.config/alacritty/alacritty.toml; Alacritty does not create the file)
https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty#faq (no tabs or splits; left to a window manager or tmux)
https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/tree/master/alacritty_terminal (terminal emulation library); alacritty/Cargo.toml (glutin OpenGL contexts, notify file watcher)
https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md (0.17.0: fixed error popup when saving the config file — live reload on save)
